answer_text:
Here are reliable places to order an Eid beauty gift across the GCC (UAE, Saudi, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). I’m listing options that typically have curated gift sets, fast regional delivery, and easy checkout.

## GCC-wide beauty retailers (good for gift sets)
- **Sephora (Middle East)** – Eid edits, gift sets, luxe fragrances; strong coverage across GCC.  
  https://www.sephora.ae (UAE) / https://www.sephora.sa (KSA)
- **FACES (KSA + GCC)** – often runs Eid promotions and pre-made sets.  
  https://www.faces.com
- **Nice One (Saudi / ships in region depending on item)** – huge selection, lots of gifting options.  
  https://niceonesa.com
- **Boots (UAE, KSA, others)** – great for skincare, bath/body, bundles; offers gift wrapping in some markets.  
  https://www.boots.com (use local GCC site/store) / Boots app in GCC

## Premium department stores (luxury gifting)
- **Ounass (UAE + GCC delivery)** – luxury beauty, perfumes, and giftable sets; often has premium packaging.  
  https://www.ounass.ae
- **Bloomingdale’s (UAE / some GCC delivery)** – beauty gift sets and fragrances.  
  https://www.bloomingdales.ae
- **Harrods / Selfridges via regional delivery partners** – for high-end beauty/fragrance (delivery varies by country).

## Fast marketplace options (convenient + quick delivery)
- **Amazon (UAE / KSA)** – wide range of gift sets; check “sold by” and delivery date.  
  https://www.amazon.ae / https://www.amazon.sa
- **Noon (UAE / KSA)** – beauty sets + fragrance; check authenticity/official store badges.  
  https://www.noon.com

## Perfume-focused (popular Eid gifts)
- **Ajmal Perfumes**, **Arabian Oud**, **Swiss Arabian**, **Rasasi** – strong Eid gifting, local delivery in most GCC countries.  
  (Search your country’s official site/store—these brands usually operate locally.)

## If you tell me 4 details, I’ll narrow it to the best 3 options with direct links
1) Which country (UAE/KSA/Kuwait/Qatar/Bahrain/Oman)?  
2) Budget (e.g., under 150, 300, 600 AED/SAR, etc.)  
3) Gift type (perfume, makeup, skincare, “self-care set”)  
4) Delivery date needed (same day / 2–3 days / flexible)
